finding: Consequential outputs consumed founder attention with obvious caveats and defensive qualification that changed no decision, boundary, uncertainty or action.
operating_rule: Retain caveats only when they materially change action, uncertainty, authority, evidence boundary or consequence; otherwise purge them before return.
proof_or_recheck: Representative founder-facing outputs and recurring defect rate.

finding: Ahmed repeatedly detects banal padding, weak reasoning, authority shrinkage, semantic drift and unsupported claims after model delivery, creating founder cognitive burden and reducing confidence in operating quality.
operating_rule: Producer first-pass QA plus proportionate independent challenge must catch material reasoning/output defects before founder return; repeated founder correction of the same defect is a propagation failure.
proof_or_recheck: Track defect classes caught pre-founder versus founder-discovered over representative outputs.

finding: A quality function can recreate the same low-value pattern if it produces lengthy commentary on minor stylistic issues rather than removing material defects.
operating_rule: Quality challenge optimises decision value, founder bandwidth and material defect reduction; it does not create a new narrative approval layer.
proof_or_recheck: Review evaluator output-to-defect ratio, founder attention saved and operating changes caused.

finding: The previous reasoning-quality lane could be read as requiring an independently staffed evaluator before any consequential destination continuation, risking another generic halt despite standing authority and high-competence commissioning.
operating_rule: Independent review is mandatory only where the consequence/acceptance contract requires it; otherwise producer QA and proportionate cross-review continue while the distinct evaluator function is constituted.
proof_or_recheck: Strategic Control integration and first destination trials.
